title: test(devtools): assert on eval spy in chrome-application-operations spec
body: Avoid asserting on `chrome.devtools.inspectedWindow.eval` directly via Jasmine matchers, as TypeScript picks up the 3-argument overload signature from `@types/chrome`, causing a TS2554 compilation error when only 2 arguments are provided. Instead, assert directly on the `evalSpy` instance.
